Comment 1 — checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps and runner-reported low-severity observations (moved out of the body for the 60 KB cap). For the wave anchor #24579, not extracted.

## Product observations (runner-reported, not clause fails)
- **conditional-rules-grid negative[1] (FAIL above):** objectui MasterDetailLines reads the parent record through fixed timers, so a stored paid invoice often loads with editable lines. Combined with the server's trust in client `amount`, an edit produces a line whose quantity and amount disagree, and the total is wrong.
- (observation, low) Author-time view validation accepts a filter value that every query then refuses (`done == "maybe"` on a boolean). A saved view can be published that can never run.
- (observation, low) Gantt places tasks with null start_date/end_date (Evidence collection, Content backlog) as zero-length milestones on today's date (10/19 → 10/19), which invents dates.
- (observation, low) The Chart named view (`showcase_task.chart`) renders without the view-tab bar and toolbar, so no switcher is reachable from it.
- (observation, low) The zoo's `f_repeater` embedded grid shows only the `#` column for rows `[{label,qty},…]`. No data columns are derived when the repeater declares no item schema, so the values are not visible on the edit form.
- (low) Hook condition fail-closed surfaces as an unhandled 500: a write refused by `HookConditionError` (#4775) answers `500 {"error":"Internal server error","code":"INTERNAL_ERROR"}` and the server logs `[REST] Unhandled error: HookConditionError …`. Repro (scratch copy only): add a hook on showcase_inquiry, event beforeInsert, condition `record.name.startsWith('qa-fc') && int(record.name) > 0`; `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry {"name":"qa-fc-abc","email":"a@b.co","message":"m"}` → 500 (expected a deliberate refusal status, not an internal error); row not written (correct). Reproduced 3× over two boots. Write semantics are correct; only the envelope is generic.
- (low, observation) A sys_comment created over REST without `author_name` stores author_id (correct) but the Discussion feed renders its author as "Unknown" (POST `/api/v1/data/sys_comment {thread_id, body}` as admin → feed row "Unknown"). Only the console UI path sends author_name.
- (observation) A mentioned member who cannot read sys_comment on the record gets a deep link to a feed that says "You don't have permission to view comments on this record" (Mei on Globex). This may be by design (comment access follows record grants).
- objectui (console 4016370a): a `type:'form'` action placed at `record_related` opens a blank CREATE form instead of the clicked row's edit form (RelatedRecordActionsBridge sets objectName/recordId on the action def; ActionRunner.executeForm reads only the page context and so sees a cross-object boundary). Repro above. Severity: P2 functional (wrong target mode, no data loss).
- objectui, observation (not scored, possibly by design): after "Log out" the login URL carries `redirect=` with the previous user's `uf__filter`/`uf__sort`; a different account signing in on that same page lands on the list WITH the previous user's toolbar filter applied ("Filter, 2 active"). URL-borne, not the per-user cache, and the filter values are visible in the URL anyway — worth a maintainer look given the item's "a filter value can be sensitive" rationale.
- cosmetic: the routed form page heading shows the raw FormView name "showcase_task.form".


## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps
For the wave anchor #24579 (not extracted).
- field-type-matrix acceptance[1]: "each of the 49 FieldTypeSchema members renders … on the Specimen — Full form" cannot hold on stock: `summary` has no zoo carrier (knownGap already says so for the API clause), and `autonumber` is `readonly: true` and is deliberately filtered out of create AND edit forms by objectui (`autoLayout.filterCreateModeFields` drops schema-readonly fields); it renders read-only only on the record detail page. Re-scope to "47 variants on the edit form + autonumber on the detail page + summary on its carriers".
- field-type-matrix knownGaps[2] is stale on this boot: `PATCH f_secret "sk-plain-123"` answered 200 on a stock `os dev` boot (a crypto provider is present) and reads back masked.
- list-view-capabilities step 5: `showcase_inquiry` also requires `message`; a createMany with only name+email answers 400 "Message is required". Add `message` to the recipe.
- list-view-capabilities negative[1]: too broad. Since the ADR-0047 amendment, `dropdown` userFilters chips ARE allowed on object list views (showcase `project.view.ts` ships them on All Projects); only `element: 'tabs'` is suppressed (verified: ignored with a console warning). Scope the negative to tabs.
- list-view-capabilities step 7: the visualization switcher is Display → Layout (a dropdown inside the Display popover), not a toolbar control.
- list-view-capabilities negative[0]: no stock view has a refused filter. The working fixture is an overlay `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.done` with `filter: [{field:'done', operator:'equals', value:'maybe'}]`: accepted at authoring, refused at query. A filter on a missing field is refused at authoring (`list-view-field-unknown`), so it cannot be used. The refusal code is not `INVALID_FILTER`: the body names the field and says the filter was not applied.
- conditional-rules-grid fixture note confirmed: INV-1002 ships one line; staging a second line over the data API (position 1) leaves its `amount` null (amount is client-computed and stored as sent), so the invoice total ignores it. Stage it with `amount` too, or through the grid.
- cascading-options / RUNNER "invite, then sign up" recipe: sign-up with a pending `role: admin` invitation creates the membership as `member`, and the invitation stays `pending`. The persona holds `org_admin` (and the tier gate opens) only after `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/accept-invitation {invitationId}` as that user. Add the accept step to the recipe wherever a non-member role is needed.
- import-wizard step 3: on Contacts the Import entry is in the header's overflow "…" menu (the long object description pushes it out of the toolbar). It is not the `object-view-import-button` that Tasks shows.
- view-type-gallery: the map's base style (`https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json`) is unreachable from the sandbox. Markers still render and the client shows its own degrade banner. Record this as environment, not product.
- action-param-widgets: the p_richtext helpText says "Renders the rich-text editor, not a plain textarea", but at the pin RichTextField is textarea-based by design (the field-type-matrix step already says so). The fixture copy contradicts the widget.
- object-hook-lifecycle: the scratch-hook recipe is now run-proven — a scratch app copy with hooks gated by a name-prefix CEL condition on showcase_inquiry (`record.name.startsWith('qa-…')`) isolates every scratch variant without disturbing other writes; for fail-closed, `record.name.startsWith('qa-fc') && int(record.name) > 0` gives a gate that faults only for the probe rows. Worth recording in fixtures. acceptance[8].verify says "returns a HookConditionError-class refusal": the wire answer is a generic 500 INTERNAL_ERROR (class visible only in the server log) — the clause should state the expected status/envelope.
- gantt-interactions: acceptance[3] (server veto) is runnable on stock with no lockField: bind a member to the `contributor` position (`POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position`), open the gantt as that member, reassign one of their tasks away via API, then drag it → 404 → snap-back + "Save failed — the change was rolled back". Steps[4] could name this recipe. Seed tasks with null dates render as milestones at today.
- v18-semantic-defaults: knownGaps[0] (pinned objectui does not build) is stale — the console at 4016370a is built and served. acceptance[2] "inline edit is offered" means the "Edit inline" SWITCH is offered (in the Display/view-settings popover at desktop width, `data-testid=toolbar-inline-edit-toggle`); edit mode itself is session state and starts OFF (objectui ObjectView docblock), so a run looking for editable cells on load sees none. Neither stock persona is an updater on showcase_task; binding Mei to `contributor` provides one. fixtures say "fresh boot `pnpm dev -- --fresh`"; canonical file-DB boot works too.
- bulk-select-all-matching: the global header search opens the command palette (`?palette=1`), not the list quick search; the list search is `[data-testid=search-icon-button]` → `[data-testid=search-popover] input`. The aggregate dispatch posts to `/api/v1/apps/showcase/recalc` with top-level `_selectedIds` (not `params._selectedIds`); the run dialog shows "N / 55 processed" and takes ~15 s.
- field-history-tracking: negative[0] should name its surface — the History tab is sys_audit_log (compliance audit, not per-field-gated) and DOES render "Website: old → new" for the untracked field; the per-field opt-in governs only the sys_activity summary / Discussion timeline. sys_activity.metadata also carries raw old/new for untracked fields by design. The task detail page has no tablist at all, so "no History tab" is best corroborated by the absent sys_audit_log fetch.
- record-discussion-mentions: the bell is SERVER-backed (plugin-audit writes `sys_notification` topic `collab.mention`; `GET /api/v1/notifications` → unreadCount), not objectui `useMentionNotifications` (exported but unused by the console); source[2] and acceptance[3]/[4] verify should cite the server path. No sys_comment refetch follows a post within ~6 s, so steps[3] "after the feed refetch" needs a reload. The mentioned member (Mei) lands on the record but sees "You don't have permission to view comments on this record". The qa-feeds-disabled recipe also works for a second scratch object carrying `activityMilestones[].type` — the live open-vocabulary probe (acceptance[8]) is runnable (scratch objects get console routes `/_console/apps/showcase_app/OBJ/record/ID`).
- predicate-relationship-traversal: list `$filter=` with OData text is refused (`INVALID_FILTER`, must be JSON); use `filter=` JSON.
- cascading-multilevel-and-clear: after an account is picked, the contact trigger is `data-testid=lookup-trigger-contact` (before it is `lookup-trigger-gated`, "Select Account first"); chosen values show as chips above the trigger, the trigger text stays "Select…".
- action-location-matrix steps[3] says log_time opens a "form dialog on showcase_task.form"; at console 4016370a a `type:'form'` action navigates to the routed page `/_console/forms/showcase_task.form?recordId=…&recordObject=showcase_task` (page heading shows the raw view name "showcase_task.form"), not a dialog. The record_section quick-actions bar renders only its node's explicit `actionNames` (mark_done, log_time, archive) — showcase_recalc_estimate also declares record_section but is not in that bar, which is correct, not a missing placement. framework pin `examples/app-showcase/test/record-action-location-hosts.test.ts` (9/9) covers the host declarations and could be named in `automated.ref` as the framework half.
- related-list-server-pagination: Contacts is not its own tab — it is a section of the "Related" tab (`?tab=related`, badge 28 = 26 contacts + 2 Field Zoo rows), page size 5 → "Page 1 of 6"; the console spells the params `top`/`skip`/`filter` (no `$`), so acceptance[0]/negative[0]'s "$top" reads `top` on the wire. Personas: qa-contrib/qa-mgr were minted with the invite+sign-up+sys_user_position recipe (search:qa-contributor-bound-member, positions contributor / manager) — knownGaps[0]'s "blocked(fixture) on a single-user boot" is stale; the recipe works on stock.
- adhoc-filter-sort-builder: acceptance[0]/[1] name `$filter`/`$orderby`; the console sends `filter=` and `sort=-due_date` (acceptance[2] already notes the `$`-less spelling). The stock seed makes the merged filter return one row, so acceptance[1]'s row-order oracle is single-datapoint; a condition pair that leaves ≥2 rows (e.g. estimate_hours > 4 alone on in_progress) would make it observable. FilterBuilder "Add filter" persists an incomplete row immediately (good material for negative[3]).
- calendar-interactions steps[3]: "drive as a persona lacking edit" cannot produce the optimistic move — a no-edit persona (auditor.demo) gets `draggable=false`, so nothing drags. Working recipe: a contributor-bound member (task_own_rows) loads the calendar with a task assigned to them; admin reassigns the row away server-side; the drag then PATCHes → 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND → revert + error toast. steps[5]/acceptance[3]: on showcase_task the empty-day click hands off to the FULL create form (required `project` that quick-create cannot fill, objectui#12291) with the date pre-filled — not a quick-create dialog.
- concurrent-edit-conflict: with a one-browser-context budget, session A can be a separate API sign-in writing with `If-Match`; the inline dialog's buttons are "Cancel / Overwrite anyway / Reload latest" (steps say Reload / Overwrite).
- grid-personalization: the console's density control offers Compact / Comfortable / Spacious (stored as rowHeight "compact" … "tall"), not the five modes steps[1] lists. Clicking Display → "Add group field" immediately adds a default "Title" group before a field is chosen.
- lookup-picker-create-new: the stacked create form does NOT pre-fill the typed term into Name (the affordance is labelled `Create new "Zeta"`, the form opens blank) — an observation, not a clause.
- import-job-undo-cancel: a hand-driven console route exists without the gated spec — Import → Preview → tick "Import in the background (runs as an undoable job)" → History → "Undo import". The Undo uses a native `window.confirm`; Playwright dismisses native dialogs by default, which makes Undo a silent no-op (automation-input trap) — accept the dialog. steps[1] repeats its poll/results clause twice. showcase_contact's list has no Import button (showcase_task does).
